name: Paul Ritchie
title: Founder & Principal
bio:
Paul Ritchie is a founding partner and serves as Managing Partner of The Ritchie Group. Paul oversees deal-sourcing and project capitalization, focusing on the guiding vision and investment strategies for the organization. Paul spends much of his time on strategic partnerships, debt and equity relationships, investment underwriting and execution of a diverse portfolio of development projects. Paul has direct experience in multifamily, industrial, self-storage, senior living, office, hospitality, and mixed-use developments and acquisitions.

Paul is a creative problem solver. He is known for his unique ability to design and execute strategies with which everyone wins. He is a team builder. He has a great mind for structured finance who also has a comprehensive understanding of and ability to build and navigate real estate valuation models for various asset classes.

Paul earned his BS degree in International Relations cum laude from Brigham Young University and his MBA, with an emphasis in Finance and Entrepreneurship, from BYU’s Marriott School of Management.
